newsitem.title: USA: Graco backlog up sharply in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Graco backlog up sharply in Q3.

text.p: Graco Inc, reporting improved third-quarter results, said its backlog of $33 million was nearly $10 million higher than a year ago.
"The current rate of incoming orders provides us with reason to be cautiously optimistic about a solid fourth quarter," President George Aristides said in a statement.

He said the results give the company "added confidence that our investments in new products, technology, globalization and world-class manufacturing are having a significant impact on Graco's long-term ability to grow profitably."

Graco, a manufacturer of systems to move, measure, control, dispense and apply fluid materials, reported third quarter earnings of $10.2 million or $0.58 per share, up from $6.6 million or $0.37 per share. Sales rose to $97.7 million from $94.8 million.

The company also said it intends to move into the David A. Koch Center, its new manufacturing and distribution facility in Rogers, Minn., in December. It said the project is on budget and is being paid for from operating cash flow.
In addition, Graco acquired about 350,000 shares during 1996 under its ongoing share buyback plan.
